title: sign.rs: content hashed twice (msg_digest + boundary_from_content)
description: sign() hashes content_mime with SHA-256 twice: once at line 53 (hash_content -> msg_digest for the SignedAttributes messageDigest) and once at line 133 (boundary_from_content -> SHA-256 to derive the MIME boundary string). For a large message body (e.g. a 5 MB attachment being signed) this doubles the hash work. Fix direction: pass the already-computed msg_digest into boundary_from_content, or derive the boundary from the first 16 bytes of msg_digest directly.
